info.name: Pact of the Legion
info.description: Pact of the Legion as a 2014 Pact Boon, from World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy).
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

description.p: You learn the Find Familiar spell and can cast it as an action without expending a spell slot. When you cast the spell, you summon a Fel Imp familiar (see chapter 7).
Additionally, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack with its reaction.
(In 2014 rules, Pact of the Legion is a Pact Boon gained at Warlock level 3.)

sheet.description: You can cast Find Familiar without a spell slot, summoning a Fel Imp. You can forgo one of your attacks to let your familiar attack with its reaction.
